entries.zh: 招旗；敌我两军（与游击队）之间所举的求和招降之旗
entries.en: flag or banner of peace raised between enemies and guerrillas; summons pennon
to drink wine; to feast, to entertain at a banquet (lit. 'eat-drink wine')

entries.zh: 盛大宴享；官府或王家之盛宴
entries.en: royal or grand banquet; feast of honor
to give a farewell banquet, to banquet one departing

entries.zh: 饯行；为远行之人设宴送别
entries.en: to banquet one who is going away; farewell feast
net for the hair (netted headband worn to bind the hair)

entries.zh: 施洗、行洗礼（所记汉字为濓，疑当作濂/漣，字待考）
entries.notes: 汉字栏标[疑]，且 Baptizar 后接短横，释义依赖西语词头与官话对音推断。

entries.zh: 圣水、洗礼用水（濓水，濓字待考）
entries.notes: 承接上条 Baptizar，濓字系待考字，据语境释为洗礼之水。

entries.zh: 捉拿、捕捉（西语词头 Baraquilos de Texar 拼写难解，据汉字捉及对音定为捕押义）
entries.en: to seize, to catch, to arrest
entries.notes: 西语词头拼写异常无法直解，汉字栏标[疑:捕/押]，仅据捉字与闽南对音定捕押义。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕便宜而所获不多（篇字涂改难辨，语义难以定夺）
entries.en: 〔manuscript defaced; gloss uncertain〕cheap and of little profit
entries.notes: 闽南栏 py ×2 标注涂改难辨且 T99 污损，篇字与西语对应关系无法确证。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕所值不多、不值多少（篇不多）
entries.en: 〔manuscript defaced; gloss uncertain〕of little worth, not much profit
entries.notes: 与上条同组，篇字原稿涂改难辨，仅据西语 Barato de poco provecho 与 M 栏 py m chey 推断。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕很便宜、价钱去得多（篇去多）
entries.en: 〔manuscript defaced; gloss uncertain〕very cheap, greatly reduced in price
entries.notes: 篇字存疑且 M 栏夹注 muy barato，词组结构无法完全确证。

entries.zh: 贱；廉价、低贱、不值钱（M 栏夹注重复西语释义 de poco balor）
entries.en: cheap, of little value; lowly, vile
